summary: Iteration 152: Tested Batch Save Mandate Linking feature. All 8 backend tests passed. The POST /api/candidate-bank/batch-save endpoint correctly accepts optional 'mandate_id' field and links candidates to the specified job as applications with stage='sourced'.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ When mandate_id is null/missing, candidates are saved but linked=0 (backward compatible)
✅ When mandate_id is valid, all saved candidates are linked to the job as applications
✅ Applications are created with stage='sourced' and source='batch_upload'
✅ Duplicate candidates already linked to the mandate are NOT double-linked (linked=0 for duplicates)
✅ Invalid mandate_id gracefully handled - candidates saved but not linked
✅ Partial linking works - only new candidates get linked, existing linked candidates are skipped
✅ Backward compatibility maintained - old payload format without mandate_id still works
seed_data_creation: Test candidates created with TESTUNIQ prefix for unique identification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch Save Mandate Linking feature fully tested. The endpoint POST /api/candidate-bank/batch-save now accepts optional 'mandate_id' parameter. When provided, all saved/updated candidates are linked to the specified job as applications with stage='sourced'. The linking logic correctly handles: (1) new candidates - creates application, (2) existing candidates not linked - creates application, (3) existing candidates already linked - skips (no double-linking). Frontend has a 'Link to Mandate (Optional)' dropdown with data-testid='batch-mandate-link' that appears in Step 2 after CVs are parsed.

duplicate_not_double_linked.description: First save: linked=1, Second save (same candidate): linked=0

response_includes_required_fields.description: Response contains: success, saved, updated, linked, mandate_id, errors, total

partial_linking.description: Only new candidates linked, existing linked candidates skipped

backward_compatibility.description: Old payload format without mandate_id still works
